frozen_traveler.name: Frozen Traveler
frozen_traveler.description: The traveler is freezing! Conjure NOUNS that could provide warmth, protection, or nourishment. You have 3 turns: reach 6 warmth for 6 HP, or 3–5 warmth for 3 HP.

treasure_chest.name: Mysterious Treasure Chest
treasure_chest.description: Three magical locks await. Read each riddle and answer with an ADJECTIVE. Two valid guesses per lock; synonyms welcome. Earn 4 gold per opened lock.

hangman.name: The Missing Word
hangman.description: Fill the missing letters in order before time runs out. Your hand has every letter you need, along with decoys. Wrong guesses clear the slots, but the clock keeps running. Win several letter items.

icy_portal.name: Mysterious Portal
icy_portal.description: The portal responds to HOW you act. Choose an action and an ADVERB each round to influence its unstable magic. Reach 6 stability in 3 rounds: 2 or more treasure charges earns 8 gold; otherwise heal 5 HP.
